# Cloudflare (OpenTofu) — generated plan

OpenTofu is the open-source (MPL-2.0, Linux Foundation) Terraform fork. This module provisions the Cloudflare
plane for the public demo surface — rendered from `architecture/deploy_topology.json`, the same single source
as `fly/` and the compose file. It is PROVISIONING only (DNS + R2 backup buckets); per-request worker compute
stays in the dispatch layer (`_repos/teleon/backend/src/teleon/runtime/dispatch.py`), and customer BYO compute stays API-key based —
never run this against a customer account.

It manages **5 proxied CNAME(s)** (public services) and **11 R2 backup bucket(s)** (one per stateful service).

## Apply (the plan is the gate)

```bash
cd deploy/tofu/cloudflare
export TF_VAR_cloudflare_api_token=<token>   # Zone:DNS:Edit + Workers R2 Storage:Edit (a SecretRef; never commit it)
export TF_VAR_account_id=<account-id>
export TF_VAR_zone_id=<zone-id>
tofu init
tofu plan      # REVIEW this diff — it is the change-verification gate (like the fly/compose --check)
tofu apply     # only after the plan reads correctly
```

## Notes
- Re-generate (never hand-edit): `python3 scripts/deploy/generate_provider_configs.py`; drift-checked by `--check`.
- State can live in R2 (S3-compatible) — uncomment the `backend "s3"` block in `main.tf` after the bucket exists.
- This does NOT replace the Fly deploy (`fly/README.generated.md`); it adds the Cloudflare DNS/R2 layer in front.
